summary: Polyrizon Ltd. filed a 6-K (equivalent of a US 8-K) to disclose a letter agreement extending the exclusivity and negotiation period under a non-binding MOU to acquire a 51% stake in Arrow Aviation Ltd. No price per share, premium, or deal value was stated. The board has not yet made a definitive recommendation; no advisors named. The extension suggests ongoing due diligence or negotiation. Mechanically, the deal is structured as a partial acquisition via MOU, now extended to June 30, 2026. The exclusivity extension reduces near-term deal-uncertainty but does not guarantee a definitive agreement. Watch for a definitive agreement or termination notice by month end.
